definitions.gloss: detached house; single-family home; standalone house
definitions.explanation: A house that stands on its own lot, not sharing walls with other buildings. Contrasted with apartments and condominiums in Japanese real estate.

examples.japanese: {一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live in a detached house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}った→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A new detached house was built in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm torn between buying a condo or a detached house.

notes:
One of the most common housing terms in Japanese. In Japan, owning a {一戸建|いっこだ}て is widely seen as an aspiration, though many urban residents live in ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ (condominiums) or ⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧ (apartments) due to space and cost constraints.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to build a detached house
- {一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a detached house
- {一戸建|いっこだ}て⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: detached housing
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧{一戸建|いっこだ}て: pre-owned detached house

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: condominium — a unit in a larger concrete building
- ⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧: apartment — typically a smaller, wooden rental building
- {戸建|こだ}て: abbreviated form of {一戸建|いっこだ}て, common in real estate listings
